alternativeAuthentication.auth.js: Login, recovery request and recovery completion endpoints establish identity rather than consume an existing session.
alternativeAuthentication.bridge.js: HRMS bridge authentication is validated through signed bridge/API-key controls in the controller.
alternativeAuthentication.empMapping.js: The HR employee-mapping integration uses a minimum-strength server secret and constant-time X-HR-API-Key validation instead of an LMS user session.
